sentences: Four masked byte-SADs with full 32-bit accumulators: D[k] = S2[k] + `v_msad_u8` of the 32-bit window S0[8k+31:8k] of the 64-bit S0 against S1, wrapping at 32 bits (S2 and D are four VGPRs).
Every source is read before the first write; `clamp` raises `Unsupported`.
**Hardware-verified on RDNA2** (`gfx1035`, wave32 and wave64 via `tools/int_hw_probe.py --oracle both`, SHADER-137).
Measured on native gfx1036 (AMD Radeon Graphics, RDNA2) through tools/hw_oracle across 64-bit sliding window and masked byte values against the 32-bit accumulators: bit-exact with the ISA reference.
